Condition report
Needle: PDFREPORT-7715
Prepared for Ash Pemberton
14 Bellwether Lane, Flat 3

 1. Roof
The felt at the north corner has lifted. Tacks have pulled clean
through the substrate and the overlap is no longer weathertight.
Recommend stripping the north third and relaying on a fresh deck.

 2. Walls
The east wall shows hairline cracking above both window heads,
consistent with historic settlement rather than active movement.
Monitor for twelve months.

 3. Drainage
The rear gully is blocked with leaf litter. The soakaway could
not be located and may have been built over.

 4. Summary
No urgent structural concern. Roof covering is the priority item.
